whyMatters.en: Little Rock act that fused goth-piano hooks with nu-metal guitars on Fallen (2003); Bring Me to Life dominated early-2000s rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 小石城乐队：Fallen（2003）把哥特钢琴钩子与 nu-metal 吉他融合；Bring Me to Life 占领 2000 年代初摇滚电台。

shortBio.en: Amy Lee–fronted goth/nu-metal crossover; Bring Me to Life is the 2003 chart spike.
shortBio.zh: Amy Lee 领衔哥特/nu-metal 跨界；Bring Me to Life 是 2003 榜单峰值。

body.en:
Formed mid-1990s in Little Rock, Arkansas. Fallen (2003) is the commercial record: Ben Moody–era guitars, string/choir arrangements, Lee’s mezzo lead and piano hooks.

Bring Me to Life (2003) with Paul McCoy’s guest vocal is the nu-metal radio handshake. The band tracks how early-2000s rock radio absorbed goth-pop melody without leaving the heavy playlist.
body.zh:
1990 年代中期于阿肯色小石城组建。Fallen（2003）是关键商业唱片：Ben Moody 时期吉他、弦乐/合唱编曲、Lee 女中音主唱与钢琴钩子。

与 Paul McCoy 客串的 Bring Me to Life（2003）是 nu-metal 电台握手礼。乐队记录 2000 年代初摇滚电台如何在不离开重型列表的前提下吸收哥特流行旋律。

note.en: Piano intro into down-tuned Riff—Paul McCoy guest rap on record, Lee mezzo lead.
note.zh: 钢琴 intro 接降调 Riff——录音室 Paul McCoy 客串 rap，Lee 女中音主唱。

note.en: Ballad piano and string arrangement—goth-pop melody on rock playlist.
note.zh: 谣曲钢琴与弦乐编曲——哥特流行旋律进摇滚播放列表。

note.en: Chugging 失真 guitar and Lee belt—Fallen-era live set anchor.
note.zh: 切分 失真 吉他与 Lee  belting——Fallen 时期现场组曲锚点。

title.zh: 哥特钢琴遇上 nu-metal 电台

body.en:
Evanescence matter for merging Amy Lee’s classical-piano goth hooks with down-tuned guitar and arena production on Fallen (2003).

Bring Me to Life’s piano-to-Riff switch and guest rap verse opened rock radio to crossover formatting.

My Immortal proves ballad strings could sit on the same album as chugging 失真.

Fallen sold multi-platinum—goth-pop melody as mass rock product.
body.zh:
Evanescence 要紧处是 Amy Lee 古典钢琴哥特钩子与降调吉他和体育场制作在 Fallen（2003）上的合并。

Bring Me to Life 的钢琴接 Riff 切换与客串 rap 主歌打开摇滚电台跨界格式。

My Immortal 证明谣曲弦乐可与切分 失真 同专并存。

Fallen 多白金——哥特流行旋律作大众摇滚产品。

body.en:
1995–2003 core story: Lee and Moody as writers; Gray, LeCompt, Boyd as live band for Fallen cycle.

Moody exits October 2003—Lee becomes sole creative anchor through lineup churn.

The Open Door (2006) continues piano/goth metal with new guitar personnel.

Lee’s vocal range and piano intro remain constant across roster changes.
body.zh:
1995–2003 核心叙事：Lee 与 Moody 写作；Gray、LeCompt、Boyd 为 Fallen 周期现场班底。

Moody 2003 年 10 月离队——Lee 成唯一创作锚点经阵容流动。

The Open Door（2006）以新吉他人员延续钢琴/哥特金属。

Lee 音域与钢琴 intro 经阵容变动保持恒定。

title.zh: 2000 年代摇滚电台哥特跨界

body.en:
Evanescence opened a lane for female-fronted goth-rock on US rock radio alongside nu-metal peers.

The Cure’s melodic gloom and Nirvana’s dynamic shifts are audible ancestors; execution is more cinematic and string-heavy.

Bring Me to Life and My Immortal remain licensing and cover-song staples.

Later symphonic rock records extend the brand but Fallen is the citation document.
body.zh:
Evanescence 为女主唱哥特摇滚在美国摇滚电台开出车道，与 nu-metal 同辈并行。

The Cure 旋律暗色与 Nirvana 动态切换是可闻祖先；执行更电影化、弦乐更重。

Bring Me to Life 与 My Immortal 仍是授权与翻唱常备。

后期交响摇滚延伸品牌，Fallen 是引用文献。
